reserved_gpu_plan: High-level reserved GPU pool plan for production POC: initial reserved commit = 48 vGPU-equivalents (NVIDIA A10g-equivalent), split across regions to meet residency and failover needs: us-east-1: 20, us-west-2: 16, eu-west-1: 12. Allocate across AZs: 3 AZs per region with >=2 GPUs pinned per AZ for AZ-level resilience. Target steady-state headroom = 20% buffer above modeled steady demand; burst headroom = additional 12 GPUs shared pool for traffic spikes. Cold-standby capacity in secondary region (eu-west-1) sized for 50% of norm to enable faster scale-up. Autoscaler policy: prefer local-region scale-up, failover to secondary region only when capacity utilization > 85% sustained for 30s or when health-checks detect degradation. Storage/KV cache replication: cross-region replication for prefixes but with local hot-cache for low latency. Expected ROI: 10-18% cost uplift vs single-region reserved but reduces outage risk to acceptable levels for settlement windows.
throughput_targets: Requested throughput: conversational chat peak 1,200 req/s (avg 256-token responses), embeddings pipeline 60k vectors/hr, reranking jobs 200 req/s with 512-token contexts. Planning SLO: sustain 80% of peak with dedicated pool; allow burst capacity for 10% of traffic via shared burst. Target concurrency per GPU: 6-8 chat streams at p95 latency targets when using quantized 4-bit model variants.
latency_slos: Customer target SLOs: chat p50 <= 25ms, p95 <= 85ms, p99 <= 200ms for 256-token responses (hot-cache). Embeddings p95 <= 120ms. Reranking p95 <= 350ms for 512-token contexts. SLA proposal asks for financial credits if p99 latency > targets for two consecutive hours in region or if cross-region failover exceeds 180s.
sla_negotiation_points: Primary asks: region-anchored uptime 99.95% per month, cross-region failover RTO <= 180s, documented runbooks and playbooks, audit log retention 7 years, key management via customer-managed KMS, sample incident credits table requested. Legal wants explicit carve-outs for scheduled maintenance and a ramp period during initial 90 days. Procurement pushing for reduced 3yr commitment to 2yr or quarterly true-up.
